reviews.title: Incredible Reliability and Incredibly Support!
reviews.text:
I’ve tried a bunch of alarm apps over the years and most of them struggle background reliability and/or completely tank your battery. SuperAlarm has completely resolved that for me. It works seamlessly, it never fails to ring in the morning, and the missions always get me out of bed without fail. Speaking of the missions, they’ve all been implemented well and work flawlessly. 

In addition to the app quality, I was super impressed with the apps customer support. I reached out to the developer support through the app with a question about my account and got an answer back immediately with a solution immediately! I think we all know how rare it is to receive a prompt and meaningful response from customer support and this might hold the record for the easiest to work with! If you’re a heavy sleeper looking for an app you can actually trust you can’t go wrong with SuperAlarm.

reviews.title: Alarms, a Poem
reviews.text:
I downloaded an alarm
because apparently the one on my phone
is no match for a college student
running on four hours of sleep and caffeine.

I tried one, then another,
looking for something loud enough,
annoying enough,
anything that could actually get me out of bed
before I miss another morning class.

And finally, I found one that worked.

Then came the price.

Because somehow,
in between tuition, textbooks,
gas, food, rent,
and all the other little costs
that magically appear when you’re a student,
I’m now supposed to pay an absurd amount of money
for the privilege of waking up.

Not for tutoring.
Not for a textbook.
Not even for coffee.

An alarm.

I already pay enough just to go to school.
I don’t need a subscription
to make sure I wake up for it.

So, unfortunately,
this alarm will not be waking me up.

I won’t be using the app.

At least canceling is free.

reviews.title: For those of you who who are heavy sleepers, don’t even bother with this app.
reviews.text:
Writing this review absolutely livid at 8:58am, about 5 minutes after my alarm that I set using this app woke me up for. The alarm was set for 7:45 with no snoozes. I’m about to miss my class that starts in a minute because this app decided to mess up on me for ZERO reason at all.

But besides functioning terribly, even the things it does right are absolutely stupid. Like locking the missions behind either paywalls or keeping a waking up streak (??? You only learn you unlock missions this way after you unlock them, an absolutely obtuse system.) Like yeah but typing a sentence or doing some math problems is not going to wake me up. And speaking of the math problems, if you don’t solve them in under a minute, it annoyingly starts ringing again. Meaning if you choose the hard math options it’s just near impossible without a calculator. And if I’m using a calculator why bother at all. You’re not even waking up by engaging your brain with some mental math, you’re just punching digits in. I’m also pretty sure you can’t upload your own wake up sounds so you just have to pray you like one of the preloaded ones. I’ve been using this corny “alarm” theme to wake me up and I hate it.

I got this app because I have a tendency to oversnooze my alarm, but when I’m waking up an hour late because of something completely out of my hands, it’s EXTREMELY difficult to justify using the app at all.
